# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta15

## Underlay resilience

- Keep Single-mower underlay availability and provider-frame selection scoped to that card's own Map API frontend metadata, even when a Multi-mower site descriptor has already been loaded in the background.
- Use Multi-mower anchor metadata only while the Multi-mower map layer is actually visible.
- Prevent stale/background Multi-mower metadata from suppressing or redirecting OpenStreetMap, Ortofoto, Hübriid or Google Satellite in a Single-mower view.

## Coordinate validation

- Treat `null`, `undefined` and empty-string coordinate values as missing instead of allowing JavaScript `Number(null) === 0` to turn them into false zero coordinates.
- Apply the stricter numeric handling to the base underlay transform, Estonia high-zoom detail, Google underlay helpers and beta14 manual calibration helpers.
- Keep beta14 East/North/Rotation controls unchanged; zero adjustments still leave provider geometry untouched.

The card still consumes integration-owned provider reference frames and contains no mower-model or datum-specific correction policy. This beta is intended to pair with Navimower 0.4.4-beta24, which separately fixes vendor zero-pose sentinel handling in the integration.
